display_name: Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund rToken

about.en: Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund rToken (rXLK) is a tokenized share of Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund, issued by Reality, Bitget's real-world asset issuance platform. Each token is backed 1:1 by XLK held through Alpaca Securities, a FINRA-registered US broker-dealer, with daily proof-of-reserves attestations, and trades as an ERC-20 on Arbitrum. rTokens are offered only to eligible non-US persons in permitted jurisdictions.
